title: Free Floater - Set Sail and Explore!
author: lordpoee
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/1ocrhollbxqh1.png?width=1280&format=png&auto=webp&s=cbb5ba2fd01373cfdab6dc0d70af9089d235f73f

https://preview.redd.it/gtqjuq6kcxqh1.png?width=1280&format=png&auto=webp&s=8d41cf708b0f35893b04fa9517ec632917267dae

https://preview.redd.it/diryujjwcxqh1.png?width=1280&format=png&auto=webp&s=05811d6a76c61588470dd55b0e6bb10a57ec4f07

  
A lot going on in this build,  
the environment, ocean, sky, wind, lighting, layered textured, beautiful lighting effects, because the water reacts naturally to the sunlight you get some wonderful lighting effects as the water deepens, you can swim, walk the isles, rent a ski-doo, rent a mini-sub, see lots of flora and fauna, whales, dolphins, turtles and more. There is even a water fall you can walk up to and slide down.  
It's a full on sailing simulator with different sail types, all skinnable, every boat is built from component parts, the hull the mast, the sails, even the engines are component parts. Most of my focus so far has been the environment system, which includes storms, rain, swells, wind gust, you boat reacts to the waves, you can even heel and capsize, I have sound that I think really puts you in the moment, very immersive, chill game. You can earn upgrades by diving for salvage, fishing and wild-life surveys.
